liquid.last3_tooltip: Jumps straight to the final sequence (the last 3 punches): you then throw the punches yourself.
liquid.failed: Cannot change phase: no final fight in progress, a transition is already running, or the game version is not recognized.

vitals.photo_mode_tooltip: Free camera driven with the game's controls (controller, or keyboard and mouse); time starts frozen (Y on the controller, E or Pause on the keyboard to resume or freeze it again) and Snake receives nothing while the mode is on. Numpad * to leave it. The game's HUD is hidden during the mode.
photo_help.title: Photo Mode Controls
photo_help.notes: Time is frozen when the mode starts. Snake receives no input and the game's HUD is hidden. Teleporting is not available during cutscenes.
vitals.photo_mode_not_in_game: Photo mode only works in game, not in the menus.
vitals.photo_mode_restart: The trainer DLL loaded in the game is too old for photo mode: restart the game, then the trainer.
vitals.photo_mode_failed: Could not free the camera (different game version?).
overlay.photo_teleport_failed: Teleport not available during a cutscene
vitals.white_room_tooltip: Against a Beauty, after the Beast form: the hidden 3-minute countdown reaches 0 right away and the fight moves to the white room, no waiting.
vitals.white_room_none: No Beauty in the phase leading to the white room (after the Beast form).
vitals.timer_freeze_tooltip: Code patch: the countdown shown by the game no longer goes down (the 5 minutes of the Metal Gear REX escape in Act 4, the time limit of the Beauty fights in the white room). It resumes from the same value once unchecked.
vitals.difficulty_tooltip: Changes the difficulty of the current game, immediately. Verified effect: this is the difficulty recorded on the next save (rank and ending screen included). No change observed in-game: a bullet removes the same life on Liquid and on The Boss (measured), and enemies don't seem more alert.
vitals.alert_force_tooltip: Automatic: forces nothing, the real state above follows the game. Picking a state puts the game in that step of its own alert and keeps it there until you go back to Automatic; the game then resumes its countdown from where it is (Alert → Evasion → Caution → Normal). Alert, Evasion and Caution: if the area is not already on alert, a soldier really raises the alarm (music, reinforcements, search). Normal: ends the current alert. In an area with no soldiers, the game runs no alert: forcing has no effect.
vitals.no_alerts_tooltip: Code patch: the game no longer computes the global alert from the soldier units, so it stays on Normal whatever the cause. Enemies still react locally to you ("!", they come to check, they may shoot if they see you) but never trigger an alert, reinforcements or alert music. Takes priority over the forced alert.
vitals.rebels_tooltip: When checked, sets the rebels' attitude toward Snake (their side's affinity meter): Neutral, they don't attack him even if he hurts them or doesn't help; Hostile, they treat him as an enemy. Unchecked, the game decides. An alert already running plays out before their attitude changes.
vitals.zone_tooltip: Affects the awake soldiers of the chosen side in the area (enemies, rebels or everyone), through the game's own functions: Kill, Knock out and Sleep take them down at once; Laugh, Cry, Rage and Scream trigger the Beauties' emotions for about thirty seconds. Kill, Knock out and Sleep also hit Gekko, Kill and Knock out (paralysis) hit Dwarf Gekko, and Kill also destroys vehicles (according to their side), helicopters and Sliders (counted as enemies; Dwarf Gekko cannot be put to sleep). No effect on civilians, bosses or during cutscenes.
vitals.infinite_ammo_tooltip: Turns on the game's own infinite ammo (like the Solar Gun) for every weapon that uses ammo, grenades and explosives included: the reserve no longer goes down and the HUD shows the infinity symbol. The magazine still empties (see "No Reload"). Unchecking restores the weapons to normal. Also gives Metal Gear REX unlimited missiles.
vitals.no_reload_tooltip: The magazine never empties: the trainer turns on the game's own "infinite magazine" (the Patriot's) on every weapon, with the magazine filled up. Also stops Metal Gear REX's machine gun from overheating.
vitals.infinite_silencer_tooltip: Code patch: the mounted suppressor no longer wears out with each shot (neither the current suppressor nor the reserve), whatever the weapon.
vitals.instant_kill_tooltip:
Code patch (see native/speedhack.c). Never applied to the player. The Lethal/Non-lethal button on the right picks the effect, whatever the weapon (Mk.2 included).
In both modes, anything with no stamina is destroyed in one hit: Gekko, tanks, helicopters, Millennium Park vehicles, Metal Gear RAY, destructible objects (gates to knock down with the tank cannon…, as soon as the story allows them to be destroyed).
Dwarf Gekko: destroyed in Lethal, paralyzed in Non-lethal.
Bosses in Lethal (through the game's own kill): Laughing Octopus is defeated by the first shot (her phases are skipped); Raging Raven, Crying Wolf, Screaming Mantis (with the doll) and the four Beauties go down on the first hit; Vamp goes down on the first shot (the syringe is still needed).
Bosses in Non-lethal: each hit empties stamina without touching health (Laughing Octopus: one hit, her phases are skipped; Raging Raven, Crying Wolf, Screaming Mantis and the Beauties: one hit).
Liquid Ocelot (final fist fight): in both modes, the first hit ends the fight (the ending cutscene starts, whatever the phase).
vitals.railgun_charge: Rail Gun / Solar Gun Always Charged
vitals.railgun_charge_tooltip: Code patch: the Rail Gun and Solar Gun are fully charged as soon as you pull the trigger (visual effect and Snake's shout included), with no wait and no dependence on solar energy. A fully charged shot's damage also applies to tanks. Metal Gear REX's laser also reaches level 5 as soon as charging starts.
vitals.lethal_tooltip: One hit kills any enemy it touches, bosses included.
vitals.non_lethal_tooltip: A hit puts to sleep or knocks out whatever the weapon: soldiers and Gekko fall asleep, bosses are knocked out (stamina emptied, health untouched). Other machines (tanks, vehicles, helicopters, RAY…) are still destroyed in one hit; Dwarf Gekko are paralyzed.
vitals.untouchable_tooltip: Code patch: Snake ignores every impact - bullets, explosions, mines, hits and non-lethal attacks no longer do anything to him (no damage, no knockback, no stun). When piloting Metal Gear REX, REX ignores hits too (no damage, no reaction). Against Screaming Mantis, her strings no longer hold Snake (as after the syringe).
vitals.invisible_tooltip: Code patch: soldiers, Gekko and Dwarf Gekko can no longer see Snake, even standing right in front of them (like the Stealth Camo, without the transparency; the camo index shows 99%), and unsilenced shots no longer put them on alert. They can still hear knocking on walls and come to check, and hold-ups still work. A switch to Caution remains if Snake stands still among Dwarf Gekko: also check "No Alerts" so that nothing triggers the global alert.
vitals.no_back_pain_tooltip: Code patch: Snake no longer holds his back, neither when landing from a high fall (normal landing, fall damage still applies) nor after crouching still for a long time.
vitals.snake_event_tooltip: Makes Snake play one of the game's actions. High fall and motions: in any posture, without the fall or the damage (a noise may draw nearby soldiers); animations meant for another posture may look odd. Crouching back pain: only while crouching still; standing up or moving interrupts it.

help.text:
This trainer reads and WRITES live into the memory of the mgs4.exe process while a game is running (not the save file): forces any already-identified field (weapons, items, stats, health/stamina/stress/Solid Eye battery...) and also serves as a research tool for IDs that are still unknown.

Requires MGS4 (Steam version) to be running with a save loaded — "(Re)connect" tries to attach to the running process.

Calibrated and tested on Steam version 1.4.1 of the GAME (not to be confused with the version above, which is the trainer's). Memory addresses depend on the exact exe version: a game update can shift all of them at once (already happened on 2026-09-24, fixed since). If a future update breaks detection (stuck on "Not connected", or the consistency check keeps failing after reconnecting), see notes.md for the recalibration method.

Single-player use only, at your own risk: this is not an official tool, it reads/writes into another process's memory, which an antivirus may flag incorrectly. Some fields remain low-confidence or not yet individually tested (see notes.md case by case). "Advanced mode" hides by default items whose in-game behavior is uncertain or dangerous (e.g. an item that crashes the game when equipped, confirmed multiple times) — only enable it knowing the risks.
